1.title: More Than What She Seems
1.description:
Emma Watson is a very serious young woman, with serious causes and serious responsibilities. She also finds herself with a serious need to unwind once in a while, and what better way to do it than to test yourself in some friendly combative competition?

But what happens when Miley Cyrus shows up across the cage bearing a long-festering grudge? Well... let's just say things turn unfriendly in a big hurry.

Special thanks to PhoenixCreed for partnering up with me on this one. I really enjoyed putting this story together, and it all started with a handful of images he created. It was awesome to have him bring my words to life the rest of the way, too.
